PreToolUse._comment: Brownfield write contract: refuses Write/Edit outside the confirmed allowlist when brownfield mode is active. Silent no-op (allow) when .sdlc/local/write-contract.json is absent or its active flag is false, so greenfield /mmo:greenfield behavior is unchanged.

Keeps the pipeline's own helpers (mmo:orchestrator, architect, reviewers, discovery) in the foreground: a background launch of one of them is refused with a reason and re-launched in the foreground. Every other agent launch is allowed untouched.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Refuses a whole-file Write to a file this session only showed as an outline.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. File-dump valve: cat/sed/head/tail of one large repo file.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. The five mmo agents run only inside a typed /mmo: command.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Small checked worker changes land as native Edits: a marker Edit is swapped for the checked find/replace, or refused.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Stamps session, prompt and arm onto the plugin's own job tools; the server refuses an unstamped call.

PostToolUse._comment: Regex, not literal: Claude Code namespaces plugin MCP tools as mcp__plugin_mmo_model-dispatch__..., while a clone's .mcp.json registers them bare as mcp__model-dispatch__.... Optional group matches both.

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Records a landed marker edit; and notices the same KIND of edit landing in a second file (the repeated-edit trigger).

Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Trigger: the third NEW file written in a chat.

PostToolUseFailure._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Sizes only; failed output is never trimmed.

SessionStart._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Draws the on/control arm once per session.

SubagentStart._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). A helper agent Opus started is a chat of its own: this records its start; its note travels on its first tool result. Ships off; always exits 0.

UserPromptExpansion._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. A typed /mmo: command makes this a pipeline session; ambient mode stands down.

PreCompact._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Marks a context reset for the ledger.

PreModelSwitch._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. lock_model: refuses a switch away from the policy's thinker model.

PostModelSwitch._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Marks a session that left the thinker model so it stays out of the savings numbers.

Stop._comment: Ambient mode (docs/ambient-mode.md). Ships off: the shim exits before node starts unless MMO_AMBIENT or ~/.mmo-ambient/ambient.json turns it on. Always exits 0; decisions are JSON on stdout. Marks the end of a turn so the board can tell when a task is done.
